lead: A complete metabolism toolkit in one capsule. MCT oil, CLA and L-carnitine to help your body use fat for fuel, garcinia and gymnema to curb cravings, plus chromium and B-vitamins for healthy metabolism — designed to support your weight-loss efforts.

science.title: More than a stimulant
science.text: Real fat-loss support isn't just caffeine. This formula works on several fronts at once: MCT oil and L-carnitine help your body burn fat for energy, CLA supports body composition, garcinia and gymnema help curb cravings and sugar absorption, and chromium plus a B-vitamin complex keep your metabolism running. A complete toolkit to back up your diet and training.

items.name: MCT Oil
items.text: Easy-to-use fats that the body readily burns for energy rather than storing.

items.name: Garcinia Cambogia
items.text: A traditional appetite herb standardized to 50% HCA, used to help curb cravings and fat storage.

items.name: L-Carnitine + CLA
items.text: L-carnitine helps shuttle fat into cells to be burned, while CLA supports healthy body composition.

items.name: Chromium + B-vitamins
items.text: Chromium and B6 support healthy blood-sugar and energy metabolism, helping your body turn food into fuel.

facts.other: Other Ingredients: Gelatin (bovine), Rice Flour, Vegetable Magnesium Stearate, Silicon Dioxide, Chlorophyll.
facts.side_text: MCT oil, CLA, GLA, L-carnitine, garcinia (50% HCA), gymnema, chromium, choline, turmeric, CoQ10, inositol and a 631 mg botanical blend (spirulina, kelp, amino acids and more). Made in the USA — 90 capsules in a bovine gelatin shell.
facts.warning: Contains bovine gelatin (not vegetarian). Not for use by those under 18, pregnant or nursing women. If you take medication (especially for blood sugar or thyroid) or have a medical condition, consult a physician before use. Do not exceed the recommended dose.

items.q: How does a fat burner actually work?
items.a: This one supports weight loss on several fronts: MCT and L-carnitine help burn fat for fuel, garcinia and gymnema help curb cravings, and chromium and B-vitamins support metabolism. It backs up diet and exercise — it doesn't replace them.
It's not a high-caffeine stimulant burner — it works mainly through metabolism, fat-utilisation and appetite-support ingredients, so it's gentler on your nervous system.
No — the capsule is bovine gelatin, so it isn't vegetarian or vegan.
Four capsules a day, ideally split before meals so the appetite-support herbs work when you eat.
Anyone under 18, pregnant or nursing, on blood-sugar or thyroid medication, or with a medical condition should consult a physician before use.
